full_page.content:
c.1898
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 9
Pg. 12 "If you desire to serve God alone why should you grow sad & complain when He requires a tooth, a finger or a limb? 12/10/98"
Wandering around in hospital be ashamed O Rel. ! Sitting - during bell for Elevation!
Pg. 13 Hum. through blunder in vestments for PP. Magister & Marcus.
How the citizens of Neapolis came to choose St. Anthony of Padua their Patron.
"The food which is taken on the royal table of the Cross is very difficult of digestion to the animal stomach. " S. Paul of the Cross.
"Origo omnium fontium et fluviorum mare est virtutum autem et scientiarum origo et est Dominus Jesus Christus." S. Bernard
"Holy Hour" June 8th - 9th '99 - sacrifice the evening before - verschlaf & P. Definitor's V.
June 21 '99 Uncharitable thoughts dispelled by offering same for conversion of sinners & for subject of same temptations.
The novena with a promise & the letter written on the Feast & received in the octave of the Nativity Assumption B. V.M. (A.D. 1900)
Pg. 14 "He that once sins, like him that slides on ice Goes swiftly down the slipery ways of vice. The conscience checks him, yet those rubs gone o'er He slides as smoothly, and looks back no more."
"Like a wayword child when about to be washed, corrupt nature complains against reason."
"If you may not practice the devotions you propose, then do more fervently what are permitted."
